title: Deadline to furnish statements
query: By when must Marketplaces furnish Form 1095-A statements to individuals for 2026 coverage?
answer: On or before January 31, 2027 (for coverage in calendar year 2026); if that falls on a weekend or legal holiday, by the next business day.

title: Who must file
query: Who is required to file Form 1095-A?

relevant.contains: Health Insurance Marketplaces must file Form 1095-A

answer: Health Insurance Marketplaces, for all enrollments in qualified health plans in the individual market through the Marketplace.

title: Plans excluded from reporting
query: For which kinds of health plans should no Form 1095-A be filed?

relevant.contains: Do not file a Form 1095-A for a catastrophic health plan
Don't furnish a Form 1095-A for a catastrophic health plan

answer: Catastrophic health plans and separate (stand-alone) dental plans.

title: SSN truncation
query: Can part of a person's social security number be hidden on the copy that is mailed to them?
answer: By showing only the last 4 digits and replacing the first 5 digits with asterisks or Xs; truncation isn't allowed on forms filed with the IRS.

title: Electronic statements
query: Can the statement be sent by email, and what is needed first?

relevant.contains: affirmative consent to furnish a statement electronically

answer: Yes, but only if the recipient affirmatively consents to electronic delivery (on paper or electronically; paper consent must be confirmed electronically). It can then be emailed or made accessible on the Marketplace website.

title: Long policy numbers
query: My policy ID is really long, more than fifteen characters. What do I write in the policy number box?
answer: Only the last 15 characters of the policy number.

title: Coverage start date
query: Which date should be entered on line 10 if the policy was already in effect at the start of the year?

title: More than five covered individuals
query: The policy covers seven family members but the form only has room for some of them. What should be done?
answer: Complete one or more additional Forms 1095-A, Part II.

title: Column B (SLCSP)
query: What premium is reported in column B of Part III?
answer: The premium of the applicable second lowest cost silver plan (SLCSP) used as the benchmark to compute monthly advance credit payments.

title: Statement sent in error
query: A Form 1095-A was sent by mistake for a stand-alone dental plan. How is it corrected?
answer: Send a duplicate of that Form 1095-A with the "VOID" box checked, to the IRS and to the recipient, as soon as possible.

title: Time to prepare the form
query: How long does it take on average to prepare Form 1095-A?
answer: 3 minutes.

title: Address for comments
query: Where can I mail comments about the time estimates for this form?
answer: Internal Revenue Service, Tax Forms and Publications, 1111 Constitution Ave. NW, IR-6526, Washington, DC 20224 (or online via IRS.gov/FormComments).

title: 9-digit ZIP match rate
query: What share of tax returns are matched to a congressional district using the 9-digit ZIP code?
answer: Nearly 97 percent.

title: Single-district states
query: Which states have only one congressional district?
answer: AK, DC, DE, MT, ND, SD, VT and WY.

title: Disclosure protection threshold
query: How is taxpayer privacy protected when very few returns fall into a district for some income item?

relevant.contains: less than 20 returns for a congressional district were excluded

answer: They are excluded from the data (items with fewer than 20 returns in an AGI class are combined with another AGI class).

title: APO addresses
query: Are military mail addresses counted in the district statistics?
answer: No: returns with APO/FPO addresses, foreign addresses and addresses in Puerto Rico and the territories are excluded.

title: AGI variable name
query: Which variable holds the adjusted gross income amount, and which Form 1040 line does it come from?
answer: A00100, Form 1040 line 37 (1040A line 21, 1040EZ line 4).

title: AGI size classes

title: What you need to check a refund
query: What information do I need to check the status of my refund?
answer: Social Security Number, filing status and the exact refund amount.

title: When to check after a paper return
query: How long after mailing a paper return should I check my refund?
answer: 4 weeks after mailing the paper return.

title: Table lookup by GIIN
query: In which country is the institution with GIIN 456DEF.00002.BR.344 located?
answer: Hong Kong (Test Bank Ten, LLP - Branch).

title: Not in the documents (late filing penalty)
query: What is the dollar penalty for a Marketplace that files Form 1095-A late?
answer: The documents do not state any penalty amount; the answer must say the information is not available in the provided sources.

answerChecks.label: says it is not in the sources
